2.209.4
Map.Bookmark
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.Bookmark element specifies a bookmark for a Map that can be linked to via an action with
Action.BookmarkLink set. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a
String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the Map.Bookmark element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.Bookmark element.
 <xsd:element name="Bookmark" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
